section_summary.extract_value: This section details the methodology of a single study involving 133 undergraduate students (mean age = 19.74) from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro. Participants completed consent forms, insight problems, and self-report measures. Creative achievement was assessed using the Creativity Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ), which provides a global score across 10 domains. Personality was measured with the NEO Five Factor Inventory (FFI).
